limit_up_price: exchange-published per-security upper limit for that date, after dated regime, corporate-action reference and tick rules; null for confirmed no-limit day
limit_down_price: exchange-published per-security lower limit for that date; null for confirmed no-limit day
close_limit_up_definition: valid trading-day raw close equals authoritative official upper limit at the applicable tick; intraday high touch is a separate diagnostic; pct_chg threshold is not a substitute
ten_percent_universe: select only when effective-dated official regime for security/date is 10%; do not infer it from current ST name or ticker prefix; main-board risk-warning treatment changes from 5% to 10% on 2026-07-06

rules.condition: qualified dated ordinary regime; exceptions excluded

reference: use exchange-approved ex-right/pre-close basis; 600519.SH 2024-06-19 PRECLOSE=1490.62 differs from 2024-06-18 raw close=1521.50
diagnostic_rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to CNY 0.01 reproduces selected vendor limits, but complete rule/tick exceptions and official source linkage are not closed
vendor_conflicts: 600518.SH 2024-07-03 reports rate 0.10 while prices reflect about 0.05
603194.SH initial five trading days have upper/lower=0 and rate=999, not verified as an official sentinel contract
